title: I review robot vacuums for a living, ask me anything!
summary: Me and my buddies. | Photo by Rose Tuohy for The Verge Welcome! I'm The Verge's smart home reviewer, and I'm hosting an exclusive subscriber AMA today at 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET. I test a lot of connected gadgets for my job, but the dominant device in my home - by both number and square footage covered - is the robot vacuum. At any given time, I have a dozen of…
